about.why.title: Why FilterTube dey
about.why.body: For 2020 one parent ask simple question for the video platform help forum: how I go take block videos by keyword? Dem answer say you no fit. Pass 2,500 parents talk say dem get the same question, and dem keep dey ask for years until dem lock the thread. I dey ask too. Then for 2023 one papa ask me straight whether I fit do something, because im pikin no gree stop to cry. I no fit hold myself, I build am. Na there FilterTube start: filters by word and channel for every family, then one calm Kids space, then Sangeet, so music fit stay calm too.
